body.heading: Set the blanket
paragraphs: Spread the blanket in a good spot, inside or outside. Sit each guest where they can see everyone.
Give each teddy a plate and a cup. Good hosts make sure nobody is left out.

body.heading: Serve the picnic
paragraphs: Pretend to pour the juice and pass the sandwiches. Say what everything is: This cake is made of clouds.
Ask each guest how their day was. Teddies are excellent listeners.

takeaway: A picnic is really just a kind way of saying: I am glad you are here.
safetyNotes: Keep real food for people only; pretend food is best for teddies.
screenFreeExtension: Draw invitations for the next picnic and deliver them to your toys.
